title: Spotify Analytics
summary: End-to-end analytics pipeline surfacing personal listening patterns and preference shifts.

blocks.content:
## Overview

Built an end-to-end analytics pipeline to process long-term personal Spotify data, applying temporal and behavioral analysis to surface listening patterns and preference shifts not captured by native platform insights.

## What I Built

Using the Spotify Web API and Python, I pulled years of streaming history and built a Streamlit dashboard that surfaces stats the platform doesn't show you — top genres by era, listening time distribution across the day/week, how my music taste shifted season to season, and artist loyalty over time.

## Stack

Python · Pandas · Spotipy · Streamlit · Plotly
